podcast.body: This duet with Blondie's Debbie Harry was a "CBGB veterans reunion" and was seen as a potential smash hit if the modern rock chart had existed in 1987, indicating its strong commercial appeal. "The chart launched a bit too late to catch their duet with blondies Debbie Harry, a kind of CBGB veterans reunion called Go Lil Camaro Go."
